references.text: The Lord answers Abraham that Sarah will bear a son, which mirrors the promise of a son in Luke 1:31.
God's promise to Abraham that Sarah will bear a son, parallel to the angel's message to Mary.
The prophecy of a righteous branch, a king who shall reign wisely, can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' birth.
The angel's explanation to Mary about how she will become pregnant emphasizes the miraculous nature of Jesus' birth.
Matthew refers to Jesus' birth as the fulfillment of the prophecy that a virgin will bear a son.
The prophecy that a virgin will bear a son, which Matthew interprets as a prediction of Jesus' birth.
